ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the extent of fraud in Minnesota, including the recent meth case and other ongoing investigations.
questions: What is the extent of fraud in Minnesota?
How are law enforcement agencies working to prevent and investigate fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and highlight the need for increased vigilance in preventing and investigating fraud.
